Type-1 Zoning Map Amendment

For 2719 W Augusta Blvd.
From RS-3 to RT-3.5

1.4. The applicant seeks a zoning change from RS-3 to RT-3.5 to meet the bulk and
density requirements of the RT-3.5 zoning district in order to allow for the repair
and renovation of the property which will remain a 3-story 2 dwelling-unit
residential property with 2 parking spaces and a proposed height of 35’.

FAR 0.887
Density (MLA) 1,330.5 sf
Building Area 2,661 sf
Lot Area 3,000 sf
Building Height 34 - 6”
Front Setback* 9.42”
Rear Setback 55.75”
East Side Setback 2.95’
West Side Setback** 0.43’
Parking 2

* 17-13-1101-B: Applicant will seek a variation to reduce the required front setback to
9.42’.

** 17-13-1101-B: Applicant will seek a variation to reduce the required west side setback
to 0.45” and the combined side setback to 3.38’.
